plan.question: Do the current skill bodies improve actual test quality over no supplied skill body and a generic control?
plan.selection: First batch: two existing outcome tasks with positive and negative grader fixtures. Other skills are ungraded by this study. Tasks were previously used on Claude; those observations are not pooled here.
plan.early_stop: After all arms have two pilot runs in a task/model cell, stop CEILING if BOTH no-skill runs pass the real implementation, preserve source and kill EVERY mutant. Otherwise complete five runs in all three arms. No task/prompt/grader tuning after observations.
plan.alpha_reason: 0.05 / four task-model hypotheses; a skill must beat BOTH comparators
plan.primary: Number of faulty versions caught, gated to zero if tests fail on the correct implementation or production source changes. Crashes/timeouts do not count as kills.
plan.statistics: Existing exact one-sided permutation test on mutation scores, per task and per model. No pooling across tasks/models. WORTHWHILE requires mean gain >= 1 mutant vs each comparator and p <= alpha against each, with no lower real-code pass count or source-preservation count.
plan.negative_controls: Reference solution must pass the real implementation and kill every mutant; naive solution must pass the real implementation and miss at least one mutant; untouched tests must miss at least one mutant.
plan.replay: Generated tests are replayed twice on the real implementation; disagreement or failure blocks a positive verdict. Hidden mutant evaluation is performed outside the agent workspace.
plan.review_gate: Before any positive conclusion, inspect test artifacts for behavioral assertions rather than source-code tripwires, environment detection or weakened contracts. No positive conclusion if this audit fails.
plan.transport: Native fresh agents (fork_turns=none), opaque trial paths, no parent/grader/outcome context. Explicitly prohibit all ambient skill files and personal/company brains; skill/control may read only their provided copy. Native platform skill descriptions remain visible, so this is a skill-BODY comparison conditional on a shared platform catalog, not a hermetic removal of every skill reference.
plan.exposure: Agent records skill files read; this is self-reported exposure, not independently verified telemetry. A reported ambient skill read invalidates the cell for causal conclusions. Missing exposure report blocks positive conclusions.
plan.falsifier: Baseline saturates the task, control explains the gain, a source/false-alarm regression appears, or exposure is contaminated. A null result does not establish uselessness on other work. No skill deletion or rewriting based on this first batch.
